The Templeof Mercury

Heart of the Temple, Mercury its Hinge, and all its Offices, co-conspirators in the Work: I bring you my whole self: my Voice, and my Joy, Will, and Intent. Deed into word. By my Birthright, the Door is open.

A practice kept in a notebook, by hand, between those words and their closing.

Six books. The first is the Way in brief, and all you need; the second is the whole of it; the rest are the things you keep near your hand. Nothing here is required reading, and the practice begins with a pen and one honest page.

The Way of Mercury

Everything you need to walk the Way, and nothing more: who you need to know, how to live, the practice and the Book, finding your Legend, the workings, the prayers and blessings, the year and its days, the rites of passage, and why it works.

Start here. Everything else on this shelf is for when you want more.

The Book of Words

Everything the Temple says aloud: the Door, the Dedication, the Invocations, seventeen callings, the sayings, ten convening prayers, seven prayers of the Work, four blessings, and the short forms.

For saying aloud. A spell read silently is a paragraph.

A Mercurial Almanac for 2027

Every day of the Calendar set against one particular sky: the fixed feasts, Mercury’s own cycle from the ephemeris, turn by turn, and the Moon, with the days the two agree.

Keep it near the Book and mark the five days you will actually keep.
